devices.title: Inventec Horsea
facts: Chinese; selected facts translated to English
Two AMD EPYC 7003/7002 sockets; up to 280 W TDP per CPU
2U2P; W x H x D: 447.6 x 87 x 780 mm
1+1 redundant Platinum PSUs; alternatives 800/1300/1600/2000 W; printed input 100-220 VAC.
32 DDR4 DIMM slots; two DIMMs per channel
PSU capacities and chassis configurations are alternatives, not all installed together. No exact SKU A/B/C ordering-code mapping supplied.
